# ILM ORA

> ILM ORA is a live learning platform by Texora AI, offering expert-led classes in Product, Design, Growth and Marketing, plus certification prep, school classes and learning tools.

## Learn
- [All Courses](https://ilmora.texora.ai/all-courses): Browse every live and recorded course
- [Workshops](https://ilmora.texora.ai/workshops): Live and on-demand workshops
- [AWS Certification](https://ilmora.texora.ai/aws): AWS exam preparation
- [Google Certification](https://ilmora.texora.ai/google): Google certification courses
- [Microsoft Certification](https://ilmora.texora.ai/microsoft): Microsoft certification courses
- [Cisco Certifications](https://ilmora.texora.ai/cisco): Cisco exams and training
- [School Classes](https://ilmora.texora.ai/board): Online school classes by subject
- [Coding Lab](https://ilmora.texora.ai/coding-lab): Practice coding online
- [Study Abroad](https://ilmora.texora.ai/study-abroad): Study abroad guidance
- [FDE Academy](https://ilmora.texora.ai/fde-academy): Career-focused training

## Tools
- [AI Companion](https://ilmora.texora.ai/ai-companion): AI study assistant
- [Study Plan](https://ilmora.texora.ai/study-plan): Personalised study roadmap
- [Workspace](https://ilmora.texora.ai/workspace): Collaborative meeting workspace
- [Whiteboard](https://ilmora.texora.ai/whiteboard): Online whiteboard
- [ILM ORA Meet](https://ilmora.texora.ai/calendry): Meetings and scheduling
- [Resume Builder](https://ilmora.texora.ai/resume-builder): Build a resume online

## For Teams
- [Student Hub](https://ilmora.texora.ai/student-hub): For learners
- [Trainer Hub](https://ilmora.texora.ai/trainer-hub): For trainers
- [Manager Hub](https://ilmora.texora.ai/manager-hub): For managers
